acceptance_criteria: Positive: a closed resource set containing exactly one resolvable declared Scenario yields a resolved plan carrying that Scenario's logical identity and its declared parameters/seed.
Negative: a missing, unresolved, or ambiguous Scenario selection is rejected with a stable structured diagnostic and no resolved plan.
Compilation starts no component and performs no registry or network activity.
applicability: Phase 1 XDL Lite bounded software allocation (offline declared experiment intent compilation). status 'accepted' records internal engineering intent only; it is not implementation satisfaction or external delivery acceptance.
statement: The Phase 1 XDL Lite compiler shall select and bind exactly one declared Scenario from the closed, normalized XDL resource set and shall emit that Scenario's logical identity, declared parameters, and declared seed into the resolved experiment plan; a missing, unresolved, or ambiguous Scenario selection shall be rejected with a stable structured diagnostic.
title: Declared Scenario selection and binding
verification_intent: Planned to be exercised through the XDL1-UNIT, XDL1-STATIC, XDL1-INTEGRATION, and XDL1-VALIDATION measures defined in the XDL1 verification-design stage, invoking the real loader, schema registry, catalog, activation-plan consumer, and additive CLI/API. No runtime, availability, compatibility, or readiness claim is made.
